Home ERPnew look · real screens, sample data Applicant Landlord Staff
Click here

Home ERP, new look

These are today's Home ERP screens, rendered from the product's own page templates with sample data. Only the visual layer changes: colours, type, corners, fields, buttons and the page header. Every field, step, button and link is where it is today. Switch New look off in the bar above to see the same screen as it looks now.

Each portal has its own colour so nobody mistakes one for another: teal for applicants, violet for landlords, navy and royal blue for staff. The landlord portal has no screens in the Figma designs, so it takes the same system in its own colour. The staff portal keeps its top navigation bar: the sidebar in the designs moves things around the page, so it belongs to a later step, not to this one. Links and buttons that lead to screens outside this prototype say so instead of opening.

New Rent Increase Request

Request a contract rent increase for one of your units

How it works

  1. Pick the unit - the current contract rent is filled in from its record
  2. Enter the rent you are proposing and when it should take effect
  3. Save as draft or submit immediately for review
  4. Housing authority staff will review your request
  5. You'll be notified when a decision is made

Most requests are "Annual Increase" for yearly rent adjustments
